title: 第 2 回（製造・物流・金融）

p1.img: A worker in a safety vest is driving a forklift carrying boxes in a warehouse.
o: A man is climbing onto a truck.
Boxes are being unpacked on a table.
A worker is operating a forklift.
p1.zh: 一名工人正在操作堆高機。
p1.why: operate＝操作機器。倉庫裡有箱子，不是空的。

p1.img: Rows of cardboard boxes are stacked on metal shelves in a storage room.
o: A woman is reaching for a box.
Boxes are lying on the floor.
Some boxes have been arranged on shelves.
p1.zh: 一些箱子被整齊擺在架子上。
p1.why: 沒有人的照片 → have been＋p.p.。

p1.img: A woman is counting cash at a bank teller window.
Two engineers wearing hard hats are looking at blueprints at a construction site.
p1.zh: 他們正在看一些設計圖。

p1.img: A delivery truck is parked at a loading dock with its back doors open.
o: A driver is getting into a car.
The doors of a truck are open.

p1.img: A man is giving a presentation using a chart on a screen to a small audience.
o: A man is pointing at a chart.
Chairs are stacked in a corner.
The audience is leaving the room.
p1.why: 簡報者指著螢幕上的圖表。

p2a.q: When will the shipment arrive at the warehouse?
Where should I put these safety manuals?
o: In the cabinet by the door.
p2a.why: Where → 地點；(B) safe 陷阱。

p2a.q: Why did production stop this morning?
How many units did we sell last quarter?
Should we ship the order by air or by sea?
Did you open a savings account at the new bank?
o: Not yet, I'll go on Friday.
It's next to the river bank.
p2a.zh: 你在新銀行開了儲蓄帳戶嗎？

p2a.q: The quarterly figures look better than expected.
Could you send me the tracking number?
p2a.zh: 可以把追蹤號碼寄給我嗎？

p2a.q: What's the interest rate on this loan?
Haven't the new machines been installed yet?
Who's in charge of the inventory count?
Why don't we hire a temporary worker for the holiday season?
p2a.zh: 何不在假期旺季請臨時工？
p2a.why: 提議 → 贊同。(C) hire/higher 發音陷阱。

o: In the lobby of this building.
It was moved to next Tuesday.

p2b.q: How do I request a refund?
Do you want the report in color or black and white?
Our main supplier just raised its prices.
What time does the bank close on Saturdays?
Would you like me to call the client for you?
Who's responsible for ordering spare parts?
Why is the loading dock so crowded?
Is the new accounting software easy to use?
o: It took me a while to learn.
p2b.why: 間接回答：學了一陣子＝不算簡單。

p2b.q: How long is the warranty on this equipment?
The meeting with the bank has been canceled.

script.t: Hi, I'm calling from Delta Manufacturing. We ordered two hundred steel brackets from you last week.
Yes, I see the order here. Is there a problem?
The shipment arrived this morning, but we only received one hundred and fifty.
I apologize. It looks like the rest were sent in a separate box. It should arrive tomorrow.
OK. We need them for a production run on Thursday.
I'll mark it as a priority and send you the tracking number right away.

p3a.zh: Delta 公司訂了 200 個鋼製支架，只收到 150 個；對方說剩下的分箱寄出、明天到；男子週四生產要用；女子會標為優先並寄追蹤號碼。

qs.q: What problem does the man report?
o: A delivery was sent to the wrong address.

qs.q: Why does the man need the items by Thursday?
What will the woman send?

script.t: Good morning. I'd like to apply for a small business loan.
Certainly. What will you use the loan for?
I own a bakery, and I want to buy a second oven to increase production.
I see. We'll need your financial statements for the last two years and a copy of your business license.
I brought the license, but I'll have to e-mail the financial statements.
That's fine. Once we receive them, it usually takes about a week to get a decision.

p3a.zh: 女子經營麵包店，想申請小額商業貸款買第二台烤箱；銀行需要兩年財報和營業執照；她帶了執照、財報會用 e-mail 寄；約一週有結果。

qs.q: Where does the man most likely work?
What does the woman want to buy?
What will the woman send by e-mail?

script.t: Sarah, the conveyor belt on Line 3 stopped again.
Again? That's the second time this week. Did you call the technician?
Yes, but he can't come until this afternoon.
Then let's move the workers from Line 3 to Line 1 for now. We can't fall behind on the Henderson order.
Good idea. I'll let the team know.

p3a.zh: 3 號線輸送帶這週第二次停擺；技師下午才能來；女子決定先把 3 號線的人調到 1 號線，以免 Henderson 訂單落後。

qs.q: What problem are the speakers discussing?
When will the technician come?
What does the woman decide to do?

script.t: Hi, I'm here to pick up a package. My name's Grace Lin.
Do you have the notice we left at your door?
Yes, here it is. I wasn't home when the courier came yesterday.
Thanks. I'll also need to see a photo ID.
Sure. Here's my driver's license.
Great. Please sign here, and I'll bring the package out from the back.

p3a.zh: 女子到物流據點領包裹，出示門上的通知單和駕照，簽名後男子去後面拿包裹。

qs.q: Why is the woman at the location?
Why didn't the woman receive the package yesterday?
What will the man most likely do next?
qs.why: bring the package out from the back。

script.t: Have you seen the new logistics software we're testing?
Yes, it tracks every truck in real time. It's much better than our old system.
I agree, but some of the drivers say the mobile app is confusing.
Maybe we should hold a short training session for them.
Good idea. I'll ask the software company to send someone next week.

p3b.zh: 公司在試用新物流軟體，可即時追蹤卡車；有些司機覺得手機 App 難用；女子建議辦簡短訓練，男子會請軟體公司下週派人。

qs.q: What is mentioned about the new software?
o: It tracks trucks in real time.
qs.why: tracks every truck in real time。

qs.q: What problem do some drivers have?
What will the man do?
qs.why: ask the software company to send someone。

script.t: Excuse me, I'd like to exchange some U.S. dollars for euros.
Of course. How much would you like to exchange?
Five hundred dollars. What's today's rate?
It's 0.92 euros per dollar, and there's a three-dollar service fee.
Is the fee waived for account holders?
Yes, if you have an account with us, there's no fee.

p3b.zh: 女子要換 500 美元成歐元；匯率 0.92、手續費 3 美元；本行帳戶持有人免手續費。

qs.q: What does the woman want to do?
How much money will the woman exchange?
What does the man say about the fee?
o: It is waived for account holders.
qs.why: if you have an account, no fee。

script.t: Jenny, did you finish checking the quality of the new batch of bottles?
I did. About five percent have small cracks near the neck.
Five percent? That's higher than usual.
I think the cooling temperature might be too low. I'd like to run a test with a slightly higher setting.
OK, go ahead. Let me know the results by the end of the day.

p3b.zh: 新一批瓶子約 5% 瓶頸有細裂，比平常高；女子懷疑冷卻溫度太低，想用稍高溫度測試；男子同意，請她下班前回報。

qs.q: What did the woman find?
What does the woman think caused the problem?
qs.why: cooling temperature might be too low。

qs.q: What does the man ask the woman to do?
o: Report results by the end of the day
qs.why: let me know by the end of the day。

script.t: Hi, Paul. Our accountant says we need to submit the quarterly tax forms by the fifteenth.
That's next Monday. Do we have all the receipts?
Most of them. We're still missing the ones from the sales trip to Chicago.
Those are mine. I'll scan them and send them to you this afternoon.

p3b.zh: 季度稅表 15 號（下週一）要交；還缺芝加哥業務出差的收據；男子說那是他的，今天下午掃描寄過去。

qs.q: What are the speakers preparing?
What is missing?
qs.why: still missing the ones from the sales trip。

qs.q: What will the man do this afternoon?

script.t: Good afternoon, Quick Freight. How can I help?
I need to send twelve boxes of machine parts to Mexico City. How long would it take?
By truck, about six days. By air, two days, but it costs about three times as much.
Our client needs them by next Friday, so truck should be fine.
Great. I can schedule a pickup from your location tomorrow morning.

p3c.zh: 女子要寄 12 箱機械零件到墨西哥城；卡車約 6 天、空運 2 天但貴三倍；客戶下週五前要，選卡車；明早到府取件。

qs.q: What does the woman want to ship?
Why does the woman choose truck delivery?
qs.why: needed by next Friday, so truck should be fine。

qs.q: What will happen tomorrow morning?
o: The boxes will arrive in Mexico.
The woman will visit the office.
The boxes will be picked up.

script.t: Michael, the board meeting has been moved from Thursday to Wednesday.
Wednesday? But the financial report isn't finished yet.
I know. Can Alex from Accounting help you with it?
That would help. If he works on the charts, I can finish the summary by Tuesday night.
Great. I'll talk to his manager right now.

p3c.zh: 董事會從週四提前到週三；財報還沒完成；女子建議會計部 Alex 幫忙做圖表，男子週二晚可完成摘要；女子去找 Alex 的主管。

qs.q: What change does the woman mention?
What will Alex most likely do?
qs.why: If he works on the charts。

qs.q: What will the woman do next?
qs.why: talk to his manager right now。

script.t: Welcome to Pacific Savings Bank. What can I do for you today?
I lost my debit card and need a replacement.
I'm sorry to hear that. I've blocked the old card. The new one will be mailed to your home address in five to seven days.
Is there any way to get it faster? I'm traveling next week.
We can print a temporary card here today for a ten-dollar fee.
Yes, please. Let's do that.

p3c.zh: 女子遺失金融卡；舊卡已停用，新卡 5–7 天寄到家；她下週出國，選擇今天付 10 美元在分行印臨時卡。

qs.q: Why does the woman visit the bank?
Why does the woman need the card soon?
o: She is starting a new job.

qs.q: What will the woman pay for?
qs.why: temporary card for a ten-dollar fee。

script.t: Did you hear that Kessler Foods wants to double their order for next quarter?
That's great news, but can our factory handle it?
Only if we add a night shift. I'm meeting with HR tomorrow to discuss hiring.
We'll need more packaging materials too. I'll call our supplier.

p3c.zh: Kessler 食品下季訂單要加倍；工廠需加夜班，女子明天和人資談招募；男子會打給供應商增加包材。

qs.q: What news does the woman share?
o: A client wants to increase an order.

qs.q: What does the woman say is necessary?
qs.why: Only if we add a night shift。

qs.q: What will the man do?

script.t: Hi, I'm interested in the investment seminar on Saturday. Is there still space?
Yes, we have a few seats left. It runs from nine to noon.
Is there a fee?
It's free for our clients and twenty dollars for others. Are you a client?
Not yet. I'm thinking of opening a retirement account.
Then I'll register you and send you some information about our accounts.

p3c.zh: 男子想參加週六投資講座（9 點到中午）；客戶免費、非客戶 20 美元；他還不是客戶、考慮開退休帳戶；女子幫他報名並寄帳戶資料。

qs.q: What event is the man asking about?
How much will the man most likely pay?
What will the woman send the man?

p4a.talk: Attention, all warehouse staff. Due to the high volume of holiday orders, we are extending working hours this week. The warehouse will stay open until ten P.M. from Monday to Friday. Employees who work extra hours will be paid one and a half times their normal rate. Dinner will be provided in the break room at six thirty. If you're able to stay late, please add your name to the sign-up sheet at the front office.
p4a.zh: 倉庫廣播：因假期訂單量大，本週一到五延長到晚上十點；加班薪資 1.5 倍；六點半休息室供應晚餐；能加班者請到前台簽名。

qs.q: Why are working hours being extended?
What will be provided at 6:30?
How can employees volunteer to work late?
qs.why: add your name to the sign-up sheet。

p4a.talk: Hi, Mr. Ito, this is Rachel from First Harbor Bank. I'm calling about your mortgage application. We've reviewed your documents, and everything looks good, except we still need a recent pay stub from your employer. Once we have that, we can finalize the approval, probably within two business days. You can upload it through our online portal or drop it off at any branch. Please call me at 555-0137 if you have questions.
p4a.zh: 銀行留言：房貸申請文件都沒問題，只差最近的薪資單；收到後約兩個工作天可核准；可上傳網站或拿到任一分行。

qs.q: What is the message mainly about?
What does the speaker still need?
How can the listener submit the document?
qs.why: upload online or drop it off at any branch。

p4a.talk: Welcome to Brightway Motors' assembly plant. I'm Victor, and I'll be showing you around this morning. This facility produces about four hundred vehicles a day. In a moment, we'll walk along the visitor platform above the main assembly line, where robots install doors and windshields. Please stay behind the yellow line at all times. Photography is not allowed inside the plant, but you'll have a chance to take pictures in the showroom at the end of the tour.
p4a.zh: 汽車組裝廠導覽：每天約生產 400 輛；會走上方參觀走道看機器人裝車門擋風玻璃；請待在黃線後；廠內禁止拍照，最後在展示間可拍。

qs.q: Where is the tour taking place?
What will listeners see from the platform?
Where can listeners take photos?

p4a.talk: Let's start with an update on our shipping costs. Over the past three months, fuel prices have risen by about twelve percent, and our delivery costs have gone up as a result. To manage this, we're going to combine smaller orders into fewer shipments whenever possible. We're also negotiating a new contract with a regional carrier that offers lower rates for long-term partners. I'll share the details once the contract is signed, hopefully by the end of the month.
p4a.zh: 會議：三個月來油價漲約 12%，運費上升；對策是盡量合併小訂單減少出貨次數，並與區域貨運商談長期優惠合約，預計月底簽約後公布。

qs.q: What is the main topic of the talk?
What does the company plan to do?
What does the speaker hope will happen by the end of the month?
qs.why: once the contract is signed, by the end of the month。

p4a.talk: In financial news today, Harbor National Bank reported strong earnings for the third quarter, with profits up eighteen percent compared to last year. The bank said the increase was mainly due to growth in its online banking services, which now have over two million users. Harbor National also announced plans to close five of its smaller branches next year, while adding more customer service staff to its call centers.
p4a.zh: 財經新聞：Harbor 國家銀行第三季獲利年增 18%，主因網路銀行成長（用戶逾兩百萬）；明年將關閉五家小分行，同時增加客服中心人力。

qs.q: What did Harbor National Bank report?
What was the main reason for the increase?
qs.why: growth in its online banking services。

qs.q: What does the bank plan to do next year?
qs.why: close five of its smaller branches。

p4b.talk: Is your business still using paper invoices? Switch to LedgerLine, the easy online accounting system trusted by over fifty thousand small businesses. LedgerLine automatically tracks payments, sends reminders to late-paying customers, and creates tax reports with one click. Sign up this month and get your first three months free. Plus, our support team is available by phone seven days a week. Visit ledgerline.com to start your free trial today.
p4b.zh: 線上會計系統廣告：自動追蹤付款、提醒遲付客戶、一鍵產生稅務報表；本月註冊前三個月免費；客服電話全週服務。

qs.q: What is being advertised?
What is one feature of the product?
What is offered to new customers this month?

p4b.talk: Good morning, everyone. Before we start our shift, I'd like to remind you that the safety inspectors will be visiting our plant on Thursday. Please make sure all walkways are clear and that you are wearing your safety glasses and gloves at all times. Also, the emergency exit near Line 2 has been blocked by pallets for several days. I need those pallets moved to the storage area by the end of today. Thank you.
p4b.zh: 班前提醒：安全稽查員週四來廠；保持走道淨空、全程戴護目鏡和手套；2 號線旁緊急出口被棧板擋住好幾天，今天下班前移到倉儲區。

qs.q: What will happen on Thursday?
What are listeners reminded to wear?
What problem does the speaker mention?
qs.why: emergency exit has been blocked by pallets。

p4b.talk: Hello, this is Jason Park from Swift Logistics returning your call. You asked whether we can deliver your furniture order to your new office on Saturday. Unfortunately, our weekend schedule is full, but we have an opening on Friday after four P.M. or on Monday morning. Please let me know which works better. Also, I'll need to know whether the building has a freight elevator, since some of the desks are quite large. You can reach me at extension 22.
p4b.zh: 物流回電：週六排滿，可週五下午四點後或週一早上送；請告知哪個時段，並確認大樓有沒有貨梯（有些桌子很大）。

qs.q: Why is the speaker calling?
o: To respond to a delivery request
qs.why: returning your call about delivering on Saturday。

qs.q: What problem does the speaker mention?
What information does the speaker request?
o: Whether there is a freight elevator
qs.why: whether the building has a freight elevator。

p4b.talk: You're listening to Business Today on WRKX. Our guest this hour is Dr. Ahmed Malik, an economist at Clearview University and author of the new book Smart Saving. Dr. Malik will share practical tips on how young professionals can start saving for retirement, even with a small salary. Later in the program, he'll answer questions from listeners, so if you have one, call us at 555-0100. But first, here's a quick look at today's stock market.
p4b.zh: 電台節目：來賓是經濟學家 Malik 博士、新書《聰明儲蓄》作者，將分享年輕上班族薪水不高也能開始存退休金的方法；稍後接受聽眾來電提問；先播今日股市。

qs.q: Who is Dr. Malik?
What will Dr. Malik talk about?
What will listeners hear next?
qs.why: first, a quick look at today's stock market。

p4b.talk: I want to thank everyone for your hard work on the Lakeview project. Thanks to your efforts, we finished the new distribution center two weeks ahead of schedule and slightly under budget. The client was very pleased, and they've already asked us to submit a proposal for a second facility in Riverside. Lisa will lead the proposal team. If you'd like to be part of it, please let her know by Friday.
p4b.zh: 會議：Lakeview 物流中心提前兩週、略低於預算完工；客戶很滿意，已請公司提案在 Riverside 建第二座；由 Lisa 帶提案小組，想參加者週五前告訴她。

qs.q: What did the team complete?
What is said about the project?
What should interested listeners do by Friday?

p5a.q: The factory ------- its production capacity by 20 percent last year.
p5a.zh: 工廠去年產能提高了兩成。

p5a.q: All shipments must be inspected ------- before leaving the warehouse.
p5a.zh: 所有貨物出倉前都必須仔細檢查。

p5a.q: The bank will be closed ------- the national holiday.
p5a.zh: 國定假日期間銀行不營業。

p5a.q: Our new warehouse is ------- than the old one.
The loan application ------- within five business days.
p5a.zh: 貸款申請會在五個工作天內處理。

p5a.q: Please contact Mr. Diaz, ------- handles all international orders.
p5a.zh: 請聯絡負責所有國際訂單的 Diaz 先生。

p5a.q: The supplier promised to deliver the parts ------- Wednesday.
p5a.zh: 供應商答應週三前交零件。

p5a.q: ------- the delay at the port, the goods arrived on time.
p5a.zh: 儘管港口延誤，貨物仍準時到達。

p5a.q: Ms. Novak reviewed the contract ------- before signing it.
p5a.zh: Novak 小姐簽約前親自看過合約。

p5a.q: The company is considering ------- a second factory in Vietnam.
p5a.zh: 公司正在考慮在越南開第二座工廠。

p5b.q: Interest rates are expected to remain ------- for the rest of the year.
p5b.zh: 預計今年剩下的時間利率會保持穩定。

p5b.q: The quarterly report must be ------- to the board by Friday.
p5b.zh: 季報必須在週五前提交給董事會。

p5b.q: Mr. Chang ------- as a financial analyst for ten years before he joined us.
p5b.zh: Chang 先生加入我們之前已當了十年金融分析師。
p5b.why: 比過去更早 → 過去完成式。

p5b.q: Customers can track their packages ------- our mobile app.
p5b.zh: 顧客可以透過我們的 App 追蹤包裹。

p5b.q: The production line was stopped ------- a power failure.
This is the ------- quarter in the company's history.
p5b.zh: 這是公司史上獲利最高的一季。

p5b.q: Please keep all receipts ------- to your business trip.
p5b.zh: 請保留所有與出差相關的收據。

p5b.q: The factory ------- products are sold in over 30 countries has won an award.
p5b.zh: 產品銷往三十多國的那家工廠得獎了。

p5b.q: The accounting team will ------- the figures again before the audit.
p5b.zh: 會計團隊會在稽核前再次核對數字。

p5b.q: We need to reduce costs ------- maintaining product quality.
p5b.zh: 我們必須在維持品質的同時降低成本。

p5c.q: The shipment was delayed due to ------- weather conditions.
Please ------- the attached invoice and pay within 30 days.
p5c.zh: 請查看附件發票並在 30 天內付款。

p5c.q: The warehouse manager asked the workers to ------- the boxes carefully.
p5c.zh: 倉庫經理請工人小心搬運箱子。

p5c.q: Each employee is responsible for ------- own safety equipment.
p5c.zh: 每位員工都要負責自己的安全裝備。
p5c.why: Each 是單數 → his or her。

p5c.q: The bank offers a ------- rate for first-time home buyers.
p5c.zh: 銀行為首購族提供有競爭力的利率。
p5c.why: 修飾名詞 rate → 形容詞。

p5c.q: Orders placed after 3 P.M. will be shipped ------- the next business day.
p5c.zh: 下午三點後的訂單會在下一個工作天出貨。

p5c.q: The new machines have ------- reduced our energy costs.
p5c.zh: 新機器大幅降低了能源成本。

p5c.q: Ms. Owens was ------- to factory supervisor last month.
p5c.zh: Owens 小姐上個月升為工廠主管。

p5c.q: We will ------- your account once the payment has been received.
p5c.zh: 收到款項後我們會把錢入到您的帳戶。

p5c.q: The contract is ------- for two years from the date of signing.
p5c.zh: 合約自簽署日起兩年有效。

p6a.title: E-mail: Delivery Schedule
p6a.text:
Dear Valued Customer,
Thank you for choosing Rapid Route Logistics. Starting next month, we will [1] our delivery schedule to serve you better. Deliveries to business addresses will now be made between 8 A.M. and 12 P.M. instead of throughout the day. [2]. Customers who need an afternoon delivery may request one for a small additional fee. Port of Belmont Sets New Record
BELMONT — The Port of Belmont handled a record 2.4 million shipping containers last year, an increase of 9 percent over the previous year, according to figures released on Monday.
Port director Samuel Okafor credited the growth to the new automated cranes installed in March, which allow ships to be unloaded about 30 percent faster. "Shipping companies are choosing Belmont because we save them time," he said.
The port plans to build a second terminal over the next three years. However, some local residents have raised concerns about increased truck traffic. The port will hold a public meeting at the Belmont Library on April 18 to discuss the plan.

p7c.zh: Belmont 港去年處理 240 萬個貨櫃，年增 9%；港務局長歸功於三月裝的自動化起重機（卸貨快約 30%）；計畫三年內建第二座碼頭；居民擔心卡車變多；4/18 在圖書館開公聽會。
